name: downshift
description: Downshift: the orchestrator chooses each subagent's model; Downshift applies that choice within your policy, compacts command output and measures the result. One plugin: hooks, /downshift:status, and the setup, audit, cost-reducer and harness-engineer skills.

plugins.name: downshift
plugins.description: Applies the orchestrator's model choice to each Claude Code subagent via PreToolUse, within your declared policy. Requires the downshift binary (install.sh or Releases).
